Question: Which widget provides a consolidated view of all tasks and to-dos assigned to an employee in Employee Center?
Explanation: The My Active Items Widget provides a consolidated view into all the tasks and to-dos assigned to the employee. It is designed to be configured and extended to additional tasks. Source:

Question: Which widgets are present on the Employee Center Pro home page? (Choose three.)
Explanation: Employee Center Pro home page includes: Content Experience, Recommended for you, Popular topics, Upcoming Events, My Active Items, Videos, App launcher, and Homepage Search. Source:

Question: What is the purpose of the Recommended for you widget in Employee Center?
Answer Option 1: Shows tasks assigned to the employee
Answer Option 2: Highlights the most relevant content based on popularity or ML algorithm
Explanation: The Recommended for you widget highlights the most relevant content for the employee. It is based on popularity or ML-algorithm (if entitled for Predictive Intelligence capabilities) that looks at similarity in employee profile to show popular content. Source:

Question: What is the widget ID for the App Launcher in Employee Center Pro?
Explanation: The App Launcher widget has the ID 'app-launcher'. It appears on the home page to provide one-click access to recently-used applications and favorites. Source:

Question: Which Content Publishing widget shows portal content with content type of Banner, generally used to show informative messages?
Explanation: The Welcome Banner (CD) widget with ID 'cd-banner' shows portal content with content type of Banner. It is generally used to show informative banners/text and shows in a carousel when there are multiple items. Source:

Question: Which is NOT a valid video platform supported by the Video Carousel (CD) widget?
Answer Option 4: Both YouTube and Vimeo are supported
Explanation: Brightcove is NOT supported by the Video Carousel (CD) widget. Only YouTube and Vimeo embedded links are supported for displaying videos in the carousel. Source:

Question: Which quick start tests validate approval functionality in Employee Center? (Choose two.)
Answer Option 1: Employee Center - Approval Hub Approve Request
Answer Option 3: Employee Center - Approval Hub Reject Request
Explanation: Two tests validate approval functionality: 'Employee Center - Approval Hub Approve Request' verifies approval functionality and that approved requests appear in the Completed column. 'Employee Center - Approval Hub Reject Request' verifies rejection functionality and that rejected requests appear in the Completed column. Source:

Question: In which ServiceNow release was the 'Employee center - Employee Profile Generation' quick start test introduced?
Explanation: The 'Employee center - Employee Profile Generation' test that verifies employee profiles are generated as per the employee definition was introduced in the Xanadu release. Source:

Question: Which plugins must be activated to run Employee Center and Employee Center Pro quick start tests?
Explanation: To run Employee Center quick start tests, the Agile Development 2.0 (com.snc.sdlc.agile.2.0) and Agile Development 2.0 - ATF Tests (com.snc.sdlc.agile.2.0.atf) plugins must be enabled. Demo data is also required. Source:

Question: Where can administrators navigate to view the full list of Employee Center widgets?
Explanation: To see the full list of Employee Center widgets, you can navigate to All > Service Portal > Widgets. This section provides a quick overview of all available widgets that can be used or cloned. Source:

Question: Which widget displays the relationships between employees in an organization chart format in Employee Center Pro?
Explanation: The Organization Chart (EC) widget with ID 'org_chart' displays the employees organization chart, the relationships to other employees, and more. This is the Employee Center Pro specific widget for org charts. Source:

Question: An administrator wants to test that a user can submit an HR catalog item that creates both a Universal Request and an HR case with linking between them. Which quick start test validates this functionality?
Answer Option 1: ESC: Post General HR Inquiry questions on ESC portal
Answer Option 2: ESC: Submit a Record Producer which creates Universal Request and HR Case
Answer Option 3: ESC: Verify Standard Ticket page on ESC for HR Case
Answer Option 4: HR: Search catalog items & KBs in ESC
Explanation: The 'ESC: Submit a Record Producer which creates Universal Request and HR Case' test verifies a user can submit an HR catalog item that creates a Universal Request. It also verifies the Universal Request and HR case are created and linked. Source:

Question: What is the purpose of the Content Analytics Site Tracker widget?
Answer Option 2: Analyze user behavior, usage metrics, and more from the user experience dashboard
Explanation: The Content Analytics Site Tracker widget (ID: cda-site-analytics) helps analyze user behavior, usage metrics, and more from the user experience dashboard. Source:

Question:
Which of the following statements is true about quick start tests in Employee Center?
a) Quick start tests are enabled by default and can be run immediately
b) All test suites pass on a default implementation with demo data
c) Quick start tests cannot be copied or customized
d) Quick start tests do not support performance profiling
Answer Option 3: Both a and c are true
Answer Option 4: Both b and d are true
Explanation: Statement b is true: All test suites and tests should pass on a default implementation with demo data. Statement a is false because quick start tests are disabled and read-only test templates. Statement c is false because tests can be copied and configured for customizations. Statement d is false because Performance Profiling can be used to compare tests. Source:

Question: Which widgets are part of the Employee Profile widget set? (Choose two.)
Explanation: The Employee Profile widget set includes: Employee Profile Details (displays basic profile and work-related information), Employee Profile Header (appears across the employee profile page), Employee Profile My Team, Employee Profile Overview, and Public Profile Visibility. Source:

Question: What does the Content Experience widget (cd-content-experience) enable administrators to do?
Answer Option 2: Deliver targeted, actionable communications to employees
Explanation: The Content Experience widget (cd-content-experience) delivers targeted, actionable communications to employees. For more information, see Creating campaigns with Content Experiences. Source:

Question: Which Content Governance quick start test provides end-to-end testing from content request creation through publishing?
Answer Option 3: Content Governance - New Content Request E2E Workflow
Answer Option 4: Content Experiences: Create and Publish a Campaign
Explanation: The 'Content Governance - New Content Request E2E Workflow' test provides end-to-end testing from creating a content request through publishing the content. This is the comprehensive test for the content governance workflow. Source:

Question: An organization wants to use base system widgets as-is in their Employee Center without modification. Which approach is recommended?
Answer Option 1: Always clone widgets before using them
Answer Option 2: Use base system widgets directly, then clone only if customization is needed
Answer Option 3: Create all widgets from scratch to avoid upgrade conflicts
Answer Option 4: Use only third-party widgets from the ServiceNow Store
Explanation: You can use base system widgets as-is in your Employee Center or clone them to suit your own business needs. The documentation recommends using them directly and cloning only when customization is required. Source:

Question: Which Employee Center Pro Kiosk widget enables login and access to the kiosk portal?
Answer Option 2: Employee Center Pro Kiosk Portal login
Explanation: The Employee Center Pro Kiosk Portal login widget (ec-pro-kiosk-portal-login) enables the login and access to the kiosk portal. This is the authentication widget for the Kiosk experience. Source:

Question: What role is required to create a task for a case in Agent Workspace for HR Case Management?
Explanation: The sn_hr_core.case_writer role is required to create a task for a case in Agent Workspace for HR Case Management.

Question: Which HR task type should be used to collect information from employees using a questionnaire built in the survey designer?
Explanation: The 'Collect Employee Input' task type collects information from employees. It uses employee forms, which are questionnaires built using the survey designer to collect information from employees.

Question: Which HR task types can be used to request user acknowledgment of a document? (Choose two.)
Explanation: Both 'Credential' and 'E-signature' task types require users to acknowledge documents. Credential requires login acknowledgment while E-signature requires electronic signature of the document.

Question: An HR agent needs to schedule an onboarding meeting with a new hire and send the invite to their Microsoft Outlook. Which task type should be used?
Explanation: The 'Schedule a meeting' task type enables creating meeting invites for employees while working on an HR case. It integrates with Microsoft Outlook to send meeting invites and requires the ServiceNow Microsoft Exchange Online Spoke.

Question: What is the purpose of the 'Mark When Complete' task type?
Answer Option 1: To automatically mark the case as complete
Answer Option 2: To show a Completed button on HR Service Portal that changes task state to Closed Complete
Answer Option 3: To send a notification when the task is completed
Explanation: The 'Mark When Complete' task type notifies the user that a Completed button appears on the HR Service Portal. When clicked, it changes the state of the task to Closed Complete.

Question: Which spoke must be installed for the meeting invite and scheduling capability in HR tasks?
Explanation: For the meeting invite and scheduling capability in HR tasks, the ServiceNow Microsoft Exchange Online Spoke must be installed.

Question: In which state must an HR task be for the 'Upload Documents' task type to work?
Explanation: For the 'Upload Documents' task type, the task must be in 'Ready' or 'Work in Progress' state for users to upload documents.

Question: Where do you navigate to access Agent Workspace for HR Case Management to create tasks?
Answer Option 2: All > HR Case Management > Agent Workspace for HR Case Management
Explanation: The navigation path to access Agent Workspace for HR Case Management is All > HR Case Management > Agent Workspace for HR Case Management.

Question: Which new suite of applications in Zurich simplifies the hiring process for hiring managers, recruiters, and applicants?
Explanation: Hiring Experiences is a new suite of applications in Zurich built to simplify and improve the hiring process. It includes Manager Hub Hiring tab, Applicant Center, Recruiter Workspace, and Interview Management. Previously known as Talent Acquisition, it is now integrated into HRSD.

Question: Which new AI agent in Zurich automatically creates a personalized onboarding plan for new hires including learning tasks and team introductions?
Explanation: Generate Onboarding Ramp-up Plan is a new Now Assist AI agent workflow in Zurich. It activates five days before start date with three agents: Input Gathering Agent (analyzes resumes, interviews, job descriptions), Plan Generator Agent (builds stage-based plan), and Reviewer Agent (presents plan to manager).

Question: What does the Zurich HR Case Planner AI Agent provide to HR agents for resolving cases?
Answer Option 2: Step-by-step resolution plan with fulfillment steps and supporting content
Explanation: The HR Case Planner AI Agent in Zurich (part of Resolve HR Cases v2) compiles case details, fulfillment steps, and supporting content into a clear, step-by-step resolution plan. Agents can review, adjust, and approve the plan, which is saved to worknotes for audit purposes.

Question: Which new Zurich feature enables pre-hires to begin onboarding tasks ahead of their start date with limited-access roles?
Explanation: Pre-Hire Experience in Zurich enables pre-hires to begin onboarding tasks ahead of their start date, fostering early engagement. Security is preserved through limited-access roles, and automated transitions from pre-hire to employee reduce administrative overhead.

Question: What enhancement does Zurich bring to HR Multi-Instance Integration (HR MII) for provider agents?
Answer Option 1: Provider agents can manage consumer instance configurations
Answer Option 2: Provider agents can initiate ad-hoc approvals and assign HR tasks within remote HR cases
Answer Option 3: Provider agents can automatically sync employee data
Answer Option 4: Provider agents can modify consumer knowledge bases
Explanation: Zurich enhances HR MII so provider agents can now initiate ad-hoc approvals and assign HR tasks within remote HR cases created by consumer employees. All 13 task types are supported, including a new 'URL' task type.

Question: Which role grants access to create, manage, and add users to groups within Lifecycle Events?
Explanation: The Lifecycle Events administrator [sn_hr_le.admin] role grants access to create, manage, and add users to groups within Lifecycle Events. This role can access Guided Setup, Manage Owner Groups, Manage Roles, LE UI Configuration, and Executive Dashboards. Source:

Question: What is the plugin name for Lifecycle Events in ServiceNow?
Explanation: The Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events plugin has the name [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events]. This plugin installs several types of components including tables and user roles. Source:

Question: What is the purpose of the sn_hr_le.min_admin_count system property?
Answer Option 1: Sets the minimum number of activities in a lifecycle event
Answer Option 2: Prevents deleting your only Enterprise Onboarding admin by requiring a minimum number of active users with the role
Answer Option 3: Limits the number of concurrent lifecycle events
Answer Option 4: Sets the minimum approval count for HR cases
Explanation: The sn_hr_le.min_admin_count system property helps prevent you from deleting your only Enterprise Onboarding and Transition admin user by requiring a minimum number (the default is two) of active users with this role. Source:

Question: Which tables are installed with the Lifecycle Events plugin? (Choose three.)
Explanation: The Lifecycle Events plugin installs several tables including: Activity [sn_hr_le_activity] for activity details, Activity Set [sn_hr_le_activity set] for activity set details, and HR Lifecycle Events Case [sn_hr_le_case] for submitted lifecycle event case details. Source:

Question: What does the Activity Set Context table track in Lifecycle Events?
Answer Option 1: The employee information for each activity
Answer Option 2: The state of each Activity Set when the lifecycle event initializes (triggered, waiting for activities, etc.)
Answer Option 3: The approval history for activity sets
Answer Option 4: The cost center assignment for activities
Explanation: The Activity Set Context [sn_hr_le_activity_set_context] table is created for each Activity Set when the lifecycle event initializes. It tracks the state of each set (triggered, waiting for activities to complete, and more). It works with the Activity Status table to provide filtering for the Lifecycle Events widget. Source:

Question: Which role can activate and trigger HR activity sets?
Explanation: The Activity set manager [sn_hr_le.activity_set_manager] role can activate and trigger HR activity sets. This role contains the sn_hr_le.activity_writer role which allows creating activity sets and activities. Source:

Question: Which is NOT a supported family release for Journey Accelerator Version 4.0.2?
Explanation: Rome is NOT a supported release for Journey Accelerator Version 4.0.2. The supported family releases are Utah, Tokyo, and San Diego. Rome is supported in earlier versions like 3.0.3, 2.0.2, and 2.0.1. Source:

Question: Which spoke must be installed to schedule Outlook meetings from Journey Accelerator task-based to-dos?
Explanation: To schedule Outlook meetings from Journey Accelerator task-based to-dos, the Microsoft Exchange Online Spoke [sn_ex_online_spke] and Retry Handler Framework should be installed. Source:

Question: What is significant about Journey Accelerator Version 5.0.0?
Answer Option 1: It is the first version to support mobile devices
Answer Option 2: It cannot be installed as a standalone application and is installed as a dependency with Journey Designer
Answer Option 3: It requires a separate license from ServiceNow
Answer Option 4: It only supports the Xanadu release
Explanation: Journey Accelerator Version 5.0.0 cannot be installed as a standalone application. Journey Accelerator version 5 functionality is installed as a dependency with Journey Designer version 1. This represents a major architectural change in how Journey Accelerator is deployed. Source:

Question: Which update sets must be loaded after installing Journey Accelerator? (Choose two.)
Explanation: After installing Journey Accelerator, the following update sets must be loaded: JA_ESC_header_menu_item-Journey Accelerator_Plans.xml, JA_Enforce_security_property.xml, and JA_Allow_Content_Delivery.xml. These are linked in the Supporting Links and Documentation section of the ServiceNow Store. Source:

Question: What is the purpose of the Activity Field Mapping table in Lifecycle Events?
Answer Option 2: Passes information from the parent lifecycle event case to an activity
Answer Option 3: Maps field names between ServiceNow and external systems
Answer Option 4: Defines field validation rules for activities
Explanation: The Activity Field Mapping [sn_hr_le_activity_field_mapping] table stores details of activity field mappings that pass information from the parent lifecycle event case to an activity. This enables data to flow from the case to individual activities. Source:

Question: After the Lifecycle Events plugin is installed, the sn_hr_le.admin role is automatically assigned to which role?
Explanation: After the Lifecycle Events plugin is installed, the Lifecycle Events administrator (sn_hr_le.admin) role is automatically assigned to the IT system administrator (admin) role. Administrators should then assign sn_hr_le.admin to at least two users and remove it from the admin role to suppress IT administrators from viewing sensitive HR information. Source:

Question:
Which of the following statements is true about Lifecycle Events roles?
a) The sn_hr_le.case_writer role contains sn_hr_core.case_writer
b) The sn_hr_le.activity_reader role contains no other roles
c) The sn_hr_le.activity_set_manager role contains sn_hr_le.activity_writer
d) The sn_hr_le.admin role contains skill_admin
Answer Option 1: Only a and b are true
Answer Option 2: Only b, c, and d are true
Answer Option 3: All statements (a, b, c, d) are true
Answer Option 4: Only c and d are true
Explanation: All four statements are true. The sn_hr_le.case_writer contains sn_hr_core.case_writer. The sn_hr_le.activity_reader contains no other roles. The sn_hr_le.activity_set_manager contains sn_hr_le.activity_writer. The sn_hr_le.admin contains skill_admin along with several other roles. Source:

Question: What is the purpose of Lifecycle Events Types?
Answer Option 2: Organize activity sets and activities together as a container, associated with an HR Service
Explanation: Lifecycle Events Types [sn_hr_le_type] are a way to organize activity sets and activities together. Lifecycle Events Types act as a container for activity sets and activities. They are also associated with an HR Service. Source:

Question: Which table tracks details about activities waiting to be triggered in Lifecycle Events?
Explanation: The Future To-dos [sn_hr_le_future_todo] table tracks details about activities waiting to be triggered. This table holds pending activities that have not yet met their trigger conditions. Source:

Question: An organization is implementing Lifecycle Events and wants the administrator role to also be able to configure COEs. Which additional role must be combined with sn_hr_le.admin?
Explanation: The Lifecycle Events administrator (sn_hr_le.admin) role with the Delegated Developer (delegated_developer) role can also configure and create COEs (Centers of Excellence). This combination enables HR administrators to manage both Lifecycle Events and COE configuration. Source:

Question: What role is required to create or upload employee documents in Agent Workspace for HR Case Management?
Explanation: The sn_hr_ef.document_writer role is required to create or upload employee documents in Agent Workspace for HR Case Management.

Question: Which roles have permission to change purge authorization for employee documents? (Choose two.)
Explanation: The EF admin (sn_hr_ef.admin) and Employee File Management Manager (sn_hr_ef.manager) roles have permission to change purge authorization for employee documents.

Question: What makes Employee Relations (ER) cases different from standard HR cases?
Answer Option 1: ER cases require manager approval before creation
Answer Option 2: ER cases have tighter security due to their sensitive nature
Answer Option 3: ER cases cannot be assigned to groups
Answer Option 4: ER cases must always have an Opened for person
Explanation: Because of the sensitive nature of employee relations (ER) cases, there are expectations for tighter security to protect privacy. This is what makes them different from standard HR cases.

Question: HR Service Delivery employee relations uses which of the following to ensure the correct people have visibility? (Choose three.)
Explanation: HR Service Delivery employee relations uses Roles, Groups, and Assignment rules to ensure confidentiality and that the correct people have visibility to cases.

Question: An Employee Relations agent is involved as an 'involved party' in a case. What level of access will they have to the case?
Answer Option 1: Full administrative access to manage the case
Answer Option 2: Read-only access to all case details and related records
Answer Option 3: Same access as a normal employee with restricted self-service view
Answer Option 4: No access to the case at all
Explanation: An Employee Relations agent who is an involved party in a case is treated as a normal employee and does not have special privileges. They can only view the restricted self-service view of the case.

Question: Which UI actions are NOT available to an Employee Relations agent who is restricted on a case?
Explanation: When an ER agent is restricted on a case, actions such as Associate Interaction, Delete, Close Complete, Close Incomplete, and Suspend are not available. Actions like Update, Ready for Work, and Cancel remain available.

Question: What is the purpose of using the Restrict button on an Employee Relations case?
Answer Option 1: To prevent any edits to the case
Answer Option 2: To ensure an involved ER agent cannot access the case even if they are in the HR confidential group
Answer Option 3: To remove the case from reports
Answer Option 4: To archive the case for compliance purposes
Explanation: Restricting a case means that even if an Employee Relations agent is part of the HR confidential group and is involved in a case, the agent will not have access to that case.

Question: What are COE security policies built upon in ServiceNow?
Explanation: COE security policies are a way to easily restrict access to different COEs via configuration. The underlying COE security policy implementations are ServiceNow ACLs (Access Control Rules).

Question: What is the default maximum file upload size for employee documents?
Explanation: By default, the maximum size of a document allowed is 30 MB. This can be changed from the 'Maximum file upload size in megabytes' field in Employee Document Properties.

Question: What role is required to electronically sign a document in Agent Workspace for HR Case Management?
Explanation: The sn_hr_core.case_writer role is required to electronically sign a document in Agent Workspace for HR Case Management.

Question: When electronically signing a document in Agent Workspace, which signature methods are available? (Choose two.)
Explanation: When signing a document, users can select 'Type signature' to type their signature or 'Draw signature' to draw their signature using their mouse.

Question: What happens to HR matching rules when an Employee Relations agent is a subject person of a case?
Answer Option 1: The matching rules are ignored completely
Answer Option 2: The matching rules skip the ER agent so the case is not assigned to them
Answer Option 3: The matching rules prioritize the ER agent for faster resolution
Answer Option 4: The matching rules create a copy of the case for the ER agent
Explanation: For Employee Relations COE, the HR matching rules skip any Employee Relations agent who meets the criteria (is the opened for person, involved party, or subject person) so that the case is not assigned to them.

Question: Which role is required to create HR cases in ServiceNow?
Explanation: The sn_hr_core.case_writer role grants access to write all HR cases. Users with this role can access Agent Workspace for HR Case Management and view, create, and work on existing cases. Source:

Question: What is the navigation path to create a new HR case in ServiceNow?
Answer Option 1: All > HR Service Delivery > Create Case
Answer Option 2: All > HR Case Management > Create New Case
Explanation: To create a new HR case, navigate to All > HR Case Management > Create New Case. Alternatively, from any case list, you can click New. Source:

Question: Which fields are available when creating an HR case in the Case Details section? (Choose two.)
Explanation: The Case Details section includes COE (Center of Excellence) and HR service fields. The COE filters available HR services, and selecting an HR service can auto-populate the associated COE. Source:

Question: What happens when you select the 'Skip verification' option during HR case creation?
Answer Option 1: The case is created without manager approval
Answer Option 2: The case is created without entering an employee name and the Employee Information section is not displayed
Answer Option 3: The case bypasses all validation rules
Answer Option 4: The case is assigned directly to an HR agent without routing
Explanation: Selecting Skip verification creates the case without having to enter an employee name or case number. This option takes you directly to the Case Details section and the Employee Information section is not displayed. This is useful for anonymous employees or external individuals. Source:

Question: Which plugin must be activated for the Document Template Type field to appear when configuring an HR service?
Explanation: The Document Template Type field appears only when the Document Templates [com.snc.document_templates] plugin is activated, and the Document Template Type field is selected while configuring the HR service. Source:

Question: What is the difference between the 'Opened for' and 'Subject person' fields in an HR case?
Answer Option 1: They are always the same and represent the same person
Answer Option 2: Opened for is the requester, Subject person is who the case is about - they may differ when a manager files a case for an employee
Answer Option 3: Opened for is the HR agent, Subject person is the employee
Answer Option 4: Subject person is optional while Opened for is always required
Explanation: If the case is being created by the person making the request, the values for Subject person and Opened for are the same. If the case is being created for a different user, for example, a manager filing a case for an employee, use the choice list to select a different user. Source:

Question: Which role is required to configure HR Service Delivery playbook cards?
Explanation: The sn_hr_ws.admin role is required to configure HR Service Delivery playbook cards. This role allows you to navigate to All > HR Administration > Playbook Card Configuration. Source:

Question: Which property determines which playbook card configuration is used when both Classic HR Service Delivery Agent Workspace and Agent Workspace for HR Case Management are installed?
Explanation: The property sn_hr_agent_ws.use_uib_playbook_card_config (default value = false) decides which card configuration is used for HR Service Delivery Playbook when you have each Agent Workspace installed. By default, the Classic card configuration will be selected. Source:

Question: Which third-party background check providers are supported for HR cases in ServiceNow? (Choose three.)
Explanation: ServiceNow supports requesting background checks through First Advantage, Accurate, or Sterling as third-party background check providers. Source:

Question: When does a DocuSign flow trigger to create signature tasks in an HR case?
Answer Option 2: When the case state changes to Ready
Answer Option 3: When the case is assigned to an agent
Explanation: When the case state changes to Ready, the flow triggers and creates DocuSign tasks for all of the signers. For parallel signing, the tasks are assigned all at once. For serial signing, the tasks are created in the order defined. Source:

Question: Which application must be installed to set up Agent Workspace for HR Case Management?
Explanation: To set up Agent Workspace for HR Case Management, install the application Agent Workspace for HR Case Management [sn_hr_agent_ws]. Source:

Question: Which is NOT a field available in the HR Playbook Card Configuration Type Values section?
Explanation: Case Priority is NOT a field in the Type Values section. The Type Values section includes fields like Footer, Icon, Description, Show SLA, Title, Form fields, Tagline, Record fields, Show Checklist, and Assigned to. Source:

Question: In HR Playbook Card Configuration, what does the 'Order' field determine?
Answer Option 1: The display order of cards in the playbook view
Answer Option 2: The order in which the activity attempts to match this configuration record
Answer Option 3: The priority of the HR case
Explanation: The Order field specifies the order in which the activity attempts to match this record. The lowest values are evaluated first when determining which card configuration applies. Source:

Question: Which roles are contained within the HR manager [sn_hr_core.manager] role? (Choose two.)
Explanation: The HR manager [sn_hr_core.manager] role contains Workspace List Admin [workspace_list_admin] and Workspace user [workspace_user]. The workspace_list_admin is an elevated role, and workspace_user allows access to Agent Workspace for HR Case Management and creates/accesses interactions. Source:

Question:
Which of the following statements is true about the Work Notes field in an HR case?
a) Text in Work Notes is visible to the Subject person
b) The sn_hr_core.restrict_guest_email property controls whether external emails appear in Work Notes
c) Work Notes cannot be translated
d) Work Notes are deleted when a case is closed
Answer Option 3: Both a and c are true
Answer Option 4: Both b and d are true
Explanation: Statement b is true: The sn_hr_core.restrict_guest_email system property allows a user to send an email from a personal email account referencing an HR case. If this property is set to false (default), the text from the email appears in the Work Notes field. Statement a is false because Work Notes are NOT visible to the Subject person. Statement c is false because Work Notes can be translated using the Translate option. Source:

Question: An HR agent needs to configure all aspects of Agent Workspace for HR Case Management including UI actions, forms, and workspace lists. Which role should be assigned?
Explanation: The HR Workspace Admin [sn_hr_agent_ws.admin] role lets you configure all aspects of Agent Workspace for HR Case Management. This role contains workspace_admin, chat_admin, ui_action_admin, form_admin, workspace_list_admin, and many other administrative roles needed for complete workspace configuration. Source:

Question: Which role allows an HR agent to work customer interactions and manage workload across multiple service channels?
Explanation: The Advanced Work Assignment Agent [awa_agent] role allows an HR agent to work customer interactions and manages workload across multiple service channels. This role is contained within the HR agent [sn_hr_core.basic] role. Source:

Question: What is the navigation path to configure HR Service Delivery playbook cards?
Answer Option 1: All > HR Case Management > Playbook Cards
Answer Option 2: All > HR Administration > Playbook Card Configuration
Explanation: To configure HR Service Delivery playbook cards, navigate to All > HR Administration > Playbook Card Configuration. Source:

Question: What determines which electronic signature service (DocuSign vs Adobe Sign) is used for an HR case?
Answer Option 2: The HR service configuration associated with the case
Answer Option 3: The preference set in the employee's HR profile
Explanation: The electronic signature service used depends on the HR service configuration. When you request an electronic signature, it can be through either the DocuSign service or the Adobe Acrobat Sign service based on how the HR service is configured. Both integrations follow the same trigger pattern (Ready state) but are configured separately per HR service. Source:

Question: An organization wants employees to be able to upload attachments directly from HR playbook cards. Which field in the Playbook Card Configuration should be configured?
Explanation: The Attachment source field is used to allow uploading of attachments. Selecting 'associated_record' allows the user to upload an attachment from the card. Note that 'Attachments read only' is for indicating existing attachments can only be read. Source:

Question: What role is required to configure an HR case template?
Explanation: The sn_hr_core.admin role is required to configure an HR case template. This is specified in the 'Before you begin' section of the HR case template configuration documentation.

Question: When configuring an HR case template, what must match between the template and the associated HR service?
Explanation: The COE (Center of Excellence) for the HR case template must match that of the associated HR service. The documentation explicitly states: 'Make sure that the COE for the HR case template matches that of the associated HR service.'

Question: Which Assignment type options are available when configuring an HR case template? (Choose two.)
Explanation: When configuring HR case template assignment, you can select either 'Named user' (to assign to a specific user) or 'Skills/Assignment group' (to assign based on skills or a group). These are the two assignment type options documented.

Question: Which system property controls which dynamic variables are excluded from HR task templates to protect privacy?
Explanation: The sn_hr_core.task_template_variable_ignore system property is used to exclude dynamic variables that might provide personal information. By default, social security number (ssn) is excluded.

Question: An HR administrator needs to configure an HR case template that requires employees to sign a document when the case is created. Which field should they add to the template?
Explanation: To configure cases that require a document acknowledgement or signature, the administrator should add the PDF Template field to the HR case template. This field allows selecting a document for cases requiring signatures.

Question: What is the navigation path to access HR Service Configuration for managing HR case templates?
Answer Option 1: All > HR Case Management > HR Templates
Answer Option 2: All > HR Administration > HR Services > HR Service Configuration
Explanation: The correct navigation path is All > HR Administration > HR Services > HR Service Configuration. From there, you open the HR service and then access the HR template for that service.
